name: grapesjs-advance-components-monorepo
description: Monorepo for grapesjs-advance-components (GrapesJS blocks plugin) and promptsite (prompt-to-site CLI).

scripts.build: npm run build -w grapesjs-advance-components && npm run build -w promptsite
scripts.docs: npm run build -w grapesjs-advance-components && mkdir -p docs/dist && cp packages/grapesjs-advance-components/dist/index.global.js docs/dist/
